prompt: Use implementation-planning to assess CALLBACK-18 from the attached repository evidence. Do not infer an authentication protocol or change code.
expected_output: Separate unranked envelopes for authentication evidence, ingress preservation, credential lifecycle, replay semantics, and failure behavior, while preserving the pre-effect authentication invariant.
expectations: Name behavior and capability owners separately.
Block verifier interfaces, credential adapters, replay storage, and option-specific tests.
Allow only characterization of current callback success as descriptive evidence.
Route owner decisions and capability evidence back into implementation planning.

Run every mandatory independent reviewer on the needs-decision revision; each returns evidence-bearing PASS or concrete findings about authority handling, decision envelopes, decision-independent work, and blocker routing.
critical_forbidden_outcomes: Inventing an algorithm, header, certificate mode, canonicalization rule, timestamp, nonce, or failure status.
Assuming a shared secret because a secret provider exists.
Parsing or applying the callback before authentication.
Adding replay storage without a replay contract.
Marking the blueprint ready or design-settled.
Recording any mandatory reviewer as pending, not run, or blocked because the blueprint is needs-decision.
